findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_float, search_sec_filings, get_filing_documents, get_filing_document, get_exhibit_content, search_filing_text, get_split_performance, get_ended_reverse_splits, get_reverse_split_authority, search_learn_guides, get_learn_guide, define_term · Private data: search_companies, get_company_profile, get_quote, search_sec_filings, get_filing_documents, get_filing_document, get_filing_exhibits, get_exhibit_content, search_filing_text, get_split_performance, get_reverse_split_lifecycle, get_ended_reverse_splits, get_reverse_split_authority, get_reverse_splits_list, search_learn_guides, get_learn_guide, define_term · Public sink: get_quote, get_float, get_float_history, get_split_history, get_split_performance · Destructive: lookup_accession_number, define_term.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_float, search_sec_filings, get_filing_documents, get_filing_document, get_exhibit_content, search_filing_text, get_split_performance, get_ended_reverse_splits, get_reverse_split_authority, search_learn_guides, get_learn_guide, define_term · Private data: search_companies, get_company_profile, get_quote, search_sec_filings, get_filing_documents, get_filing_document, get_filing_exhibits, get_exhibit_content, search_filing_text, get_split_performance, get_reverse_split_lifecycle, get_ended_reverse_splits, get_reverse_split_authority, get_reverse_splits_list, search_learn_guides, get_learn_guide, define_term · Public sink: get_quote, get_float, get_float_history, get_split_history, get_split_performance · Destructive: lookup_accession_number, define_term

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
